Moorea Coral Reef Productivity Analysis: Long-term Ecosystem Dynamics

Author

Nyssa Silbiger

Published

July 13, 2026

Introduction

This report analyzes long-term ecosystem dynamics at LTER Site 1 in Moorea, French Polynesia. We examine relationships between benthic community composition, environmental conditions, fish assemblages, and ecosystem metabolism over nearly two decades (2005-2025). The analysis integrates multiple datasets to understand how coral reef ecosystems are responding to environmental change.

Data

1. Temperature Data

Extract yearly average and maximum daily temperature values from the backreef temperature time series.

Code 
# Read and process temperature data
Temp_LTER1 <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER02_BTM_Backreef_Forereef_20251114.csv")) |>
  filter(reef_type_code == "Backreef")

# Calculate daily means, then yearly statistics (optimized with single pass)
Mean_year_Temp <- Temp_LTER1 |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time_local)) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(daily_temp = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Year = year(date)) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    Mean_temp = mean(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_temp = max(daily_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Save processed data
write_csv(Mean_year_Temp, here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

# Quick summary

2. Nutrient Data

Process macroalgae tissue nitrogen content and water column nutrients, using tissue N to impute missing water column data.

Code 
# Turbinaria %N data (tissue nitrogen as nutrient proxy)
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Macroalgal_CHN_2005_to_2024_20250616.csv")) |>
  filter(
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Genus == "Turbinaria",
    Site == "LTER_1",
    !is.na(N)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    N_percent = mean(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    C_percent = mean(C, na.rm = TRUE),
    CN = mean(CN_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(Turb, here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))

# Water column nutrients (bimonthly surveys 2005-2018)
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "WaterColumnN.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Date = mdy(Date),
    Year = year(Date)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(across(Phosphate:Nitrite_and_Nitrate,  \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Site = "LTER 1")

write_csv(water, here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))

# Combine tissue and water column nutrient data into a single table
AllNutrients <- Turb |>
  full_join(water, by = "Year") |>
  arrange(Year)

# Water column N+N was only measured through 2018, so we use the tight linear
# relationship between Turbinaria tissue %N (measured 2005–2024) and dissolved
# N+N to interpret the results
modN <- lm(Nitrite_and_Nitrate ~ N_percent, data = AllNutrients)
AllNutrients$NN_impute <- predict(modN, newdata = AllNutrients)

summary(modN)

3. Benthic Cover Data

Calculate percent cover for functional groups from benthic transect surveys.

Code 
# Read and classify benthic data
BenthicCover_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Survey_Benthic_Cover_20251009.csv")) |>
  filter(Habitat == "Backreef")

# Collapse the 50+ taxa in the raw data into broad functional groups based on
# ecological role. The long list of algal species and turf categories all go
# into "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf" because they compete with coral for space
# in similar ways. A handful of uncommon categories (sponges, Tridacna, no
# data entries) are grouped as "Sand" since they occupy space but aren't (<0.5%)
# functionally important to our questions. Everything else keeps its name.
Benthic_summary_Algae <- BenthicCover_Algae |>
  rename(name = Taxonomy_Substrate_Functional_Group) |>
  mutate(
    name = case_when(
      name %in% c(
        "Amansia rhodantha", "Turbinaria ornata", "Dictyota sp.", "Halimeda sp.",
        "Galaxaura sp.", "Liagora ceranoides", "Cyanophyta", "Halimeda minima",
        "Amphiroa fragilissima", "Caulerpa serrulata", "Corallimorpharia",
        "Dictyota friabilis", "Galaxaura rugosa", "Cladophoropsis membranacea",
        "Galaxaura filamentosa", "Halimeda discoidea", "Peyssonnelia inamoena",
        "Caulerpa racemosa", "Valonia ventricosa", "Actinotrichia fragilis",
        "Dictyota bartayresiana", "Microdictyon umbilicatum", "Halimeda distorta",
        "Halimeda incrassata", "Halimeda macroloba", "Dictyota implexa",
        "Gelidiella acerosa", "Dictyosphaeria cavernosa", "Valonia aegagropila",
        "Microdictyon okamurae", "Halimeda opuntia", "Dichotomaria obtusata",
        "Chlorodesmis fastigiata", "Phyllodictyon anastomosans", "Phormidium sp.",
        "Cladophoropsis luxurians", "Sargassum pacificum", "Chnoospora implexa",
        "Halimeda taenicola", "Boodlea kaeneana", "Padina boryana",
        "Coelothrix irregularis", "Gelidiella sp.", "Hydroclathrus clathratus",
        "Dictyota divaricata", "Hypnea spinella", "Dichotomaria marginata",
        "Sporolithon sp.", "Chaetomorpha antennina", "Asparagopsis taxiformis", "Algal Turf", "Damselfish Turf", "Coral Rubble",
        "Lobophora variegata", "Shell Debris", "Bare Space"
      ) ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf",
      name %in% c(
        "Peyssonnelia bornetii", "Peyssonnelia sp.",
        "Sponge", "Tridacna sp.", "No data"
      ) ~ "Sand",
      TRUE ~ name
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, Site, name) |>
  summarise(
    total_cover = sum(Percent_Cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cover = 100 * total_cover / 5000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Site = str_replace_all(Site, "_", " "))

write_csv(Benthic_summary_Algae, here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Calculate total calcifiers and living cover
Total_Calc <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  reframe(total_Calc = sum(mean_cover))

TotalLiving <- Benthic_summary_Algae |>
  filter(name %in% c("Coral", "Crustose Corallines", "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf")) |>
  group_by(Year, Site) |>
  summarise(
    mean_alive = sum(mean_cover),
    mean_fleshy = sum(mean_cover[name == "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coral = sum(mean_cover[name == "Coral"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

4. Fish Biomass Data

Process fish survey data by trophic groups.

Code 
# Read and process fish data
fish <- read_csv(here("Data", "raw_data", "MCR_LTER_Annual_Fish_Survey_20260304.csv"))

# Process fish into trophic groups. We drop three large sharks (Biomass > 8000 g)
# that show up in the dataset — keeping them would severely bias the "Other"
# category and obscure trends in the ecologically relevant trophic groups.
# Negative Biomass values are a data coding convention for missing observations,
# not real measurements, so those are filtered out too.
fish_summary <- fish |>
  filter(
    Site == "LTER_1",
    Habitat == "Backreef",
    Biomass < 8000, # Remove outlier sharks
    Biomass >= 0 # Remove negative (missing) values
  ) |>
  mutate(
    trophic_new = case_when(
      Fine_Trophic %in% c("Brusher", "Browser", "Excavator","Concealed Cropper","Cropper",                                    "Scraper","Herbivore/Detritivore") ~ "Herbivores",
      Fine_Trophic == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(Year, trophic_new) |>
  summarise(
    fish_g_m2 = sum(Biomass, na.rm = TRUE) / 1200, # 4 transects × 300 m²
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(fish_summary, here("Data", "fish_summary.csv"))

5. Primary Production Processing

Process raw production data and extract Pmax and Rd using Bayesian photosynthesis-irradiance curves.

Code 
# Read all QC PP files efficiently
filedir <- here("Data", "raw_data", "QC_PP")
files <- dir(path = filedir, pattern = ".csv", full.names = TRUE)

All_PP_data <- files |>
  set_names() |>
  map_df(read_csv, .id = "filename", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(DateTime = mdy_hm(DateTime))

# The instrument setup changed in April 2014, shifting the output units from
# mg O2/m2/h to umol O2/m2/h. Convert the earlier records to match, then
# build date variables and drop a handful of deployment days with known QC
# issues (equipment failures, storm interference).
All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    # Convert 2007–2014 records from g O2/m2/h to mmol O2/m2/h
    across(
      c(UP_Oxy, DN_Oxy, PP),
      ~ if_else(DateTime < ymd_hms("2014-04-01 00:00:00"), (.x / 32) * 1000, .x)
    ),
    Date = as_date(DateTime),
    DielDateTime = DateTime + hours(12),
    DielDate = as_date(DielDateTime),
    Year = year(DateTime)
  ) |>
  filter(!Date %in% mdy(c("5/27/2011", "5/28/2011", "1/21/2014", "05/25/2024")))

# Keep only days with all 24 hourly measurements — partial days would
# bias the daily metabolic integrals (e.g., missing nighttime R hours

complete_dates <- All_PP_data |>
  count(DielDate) |>
  filter(n == 24)

All_PP_data <- complete_dates |>
  left_join(All_PP_data, by = "DielDate")

# Calculate GP and environmental averages
Daily_R <- All_PP_data |>
  group_by(Year, Season, DielDate) |>
  summarise(R_average = mean(PP[PAR == 0], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

All_PP_data <- All_PP_data |>
  left_join(Daily_R, by = c("Year", "Season", "DielDate")) |>
  mutate(
    GP = if_else(PAR == 0, NA_real_, PP - R_average),
    GP = if_else(GP < 0, NA_real_, GP),
    Temperature_mean = (UP_Temp + DN_Temp) / 2,
    Flow_mean = (UP_Velocity_mps + DN_Velocity_mps) / 2
  )

# Calculate yearly averages
Year_Averages_PP <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    NP = PP,
    R = if_else(PP < 0, PP, NA_real_)
  ) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  summarise(
    NP_mean = mean(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    NP_SE = sd(NP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    NP_max = max(NP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_mean = mean(GP, na.rm = TRUE),
    GP_SE = sd(GP, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    R_mean = mean(R, na.rm = TRUE),
    R_SE = sd(R, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    Temperature_mean = mean(Temperature_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_mean = mean(Flow_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PAR_mean = mean(PAR[PAR > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Bayesian Photosynthesis-Irradiance (PI) Curve Analysis

We fit a Bayesian non-linear model to extract photosynthetic parameters (alpha, Pmax, and Rd) for each year. The model uses a rectangular hyperbola:

\[PP = \frac{\alpha \cdot P_{max} \cdot PAR}{\alpha \cdot PAR + P_{max}} + R_d\]

where: - \(\alpha\) = initial slope (photosynthetic efficiency) - \(P_{max}\) = maximum photosynthetic capacity - \(R_d\) = dark respiration (ecosystem respiration) - \(PAR\) = photosynthetically active radiation

Code 
# Bayesian PI curves to extract light-independent Pmax and Rd
LTER1_Pnet <- All_PP_data |>
  mutate(
    tempc = Temperature_mean,
    Flowmean = Flow_mean,
    flow_log = log(Flowmean),
    UPDN = as.factor(UPDN),
    Year = as.factor(Year)
  )

# Fit the PI curve as a Bayesian non-linear model rather than ordinary least
# squares because we need full uncertainty estimates on Pmax and Rd for each
# year — those uncertainties propagate through the SEM later. The Student-t
# likelihood handles the occasional outlier measurement without letting it
# distort the curve. All three parameters (alpha, Pmax, Rd) are estimated
# simultaneously across all years, with year-specific coefficients for each.
# This will take a while — run with cache: true.
fit1_f <- brm(
  bf(
    PP ~ ((alpha * Pmax * PAR) / (alpha * PAR + Pmax)) + Rd,
    nl = TRUE,
    alpha ~ 0 + Year,
    Pmax ~ 0 + Year,
    Rd ~ 0 + Year
  ) + student(),
  data = LTER1_Pnet,
  set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0.1, 10), nlpar = "alpha", lb = 0),
    prior(normal(-100, 10), nlpar = "Rd", ub = 0),
    prior(normal(100, 10), nlpar = "Pmax", lb = 0)
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 20),
  cores = 3,
  chains = 3,
  seed = 223,
  iter = 8000,
  warmup = 2000
)

# Extract Pmax and Rd coefficients
names <- rownames(fixef(fit1_f))
coefficients <- as_tibble(fixef(fit1_f)) |>
  mutate(params = names)

PRValues <- coefficients |>
  separate(params, sep = "_", into = c("param_type", "yearname"), remove = FALSE) |>
  filter(param_type %in% c("Pmax", "Rd")) |>
  separate(yearname, sep = "r", into = c("y", "year")) |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  select(Year = year, Estimate, param_type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = param_type, values_from = Estimate)

# Combine with raw averages
Year_Averages_PP <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(PRValues, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(Rd = -Rd) # Make Rd positive

# Calculate Bayesian R²
pi_curve_r2 <- median(bayes_R2(fit1_f)[, 1])
cat(sprintf("\nPhotosynthesis-Irradiance Curve Model:\n"))

Photosynthesis-Irradiance Curve Model:
Code

6. Integrate All Datasets

Code 
# Read processed data files
Year_Averages_PP <- read_csv(here("Data", "Year_Averages_PP.csv"))
Turb <- read_csv(here("Data", "Turb_mean.csv"))
water <- read_csv(here("Data", "Water_N_mean.csv"))
insitu_temp <- read_csv(here("Data", "InSituTemp.csv"))

fish_trophic <- read_csv(here("Data", "fish_summary.csv")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = trophic_new, values_from = fish_g_m2) |>
  select(-Other)

Benthic_summary_Algae <- read_csv(here("Data", "Benthic_summary_algae.csv"))

# Create integrated dataset
Year_Averages <- Year_Averages_PP |>
  full_join(TotalLiving |> filter(Site == "LTER 1"), by = "Year") |>
  full_join(water) |>
  full_join(Turb, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(insitu_temp, by = "Year") |>
  full_join(fish_trophic, by = "Year") |>
  mutate(log_coral = log(mean_coral)) |>
  filter(Year < 2026) |>
  arrange(Year)

Temporal Trends

Assess standardized change per year using Bayesian linear models.

Code 
# Create standardized dataset
std_data <- Year_Averages |>
  select(
    mean_coral, mean_fleshy, Pmax, Rd, N_percent,
    Herbivores, Corallivore, NP_mean, Max_temp, GP_mean,
    Nitrite_and_Nitrate, Phosphate
  ) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)))) |>
  bind_cols(Year_Averages |> select(Year))

# Fit Bayesian models for each variable and extract R²
fit_temporal_model <- function(response_var, param_name) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(response_var, "~ Year"))
  mod <- brm(form, data = std_data, silent = 2, refresh = 0, seed = 223)
  
  # Extract posterior samples
  post <- as_tibble(as.matrix(mod)) |>
    select(Year = b_Year) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param_name)
  
  # Calculate Bayesian R²
  r2 <- median(bayes_R2(mod)[, 1])
  
  # Store model for later R² extraction
  list(posterior = post, model = mod, r2 = r2, param = param_name)
}

# Fit all models
temporal_models <- list(
  fit_temporal_model("mean_coral", "% Coral Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("mean_fleshy", "% Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover"),
  fit_temporal_model("Corallivore", "Corallivore"),
  fit_temporal_model("Herbivores", "Herbivore/bioeroding fish"),
  fit_temporal_model("N_percent", "%N Content"),
  fit_temporal_model("Rd", "Ecosystem Respiration"),
  fit_temporal_model("Pmax", "Maximum Photosynthetic Capacity"),
  fit_temporal_model("NP_mean", "Net Ecosystem Production"),
  fit_temporal_model("Max_temp", "Max Temperature"),
  fit_temporal_model("Nitrite_and_Nitrate", "Nitrate + Nitrite")
)

# Extract posteriors for plotting
temporal_results <- temporal_models |>
  map_df(~.x$posterior)

# Print R² values
cat("\n=== Temporal Trend Model Performance (Bayesian R²) ===\n\n")

# Pull fitted values and raw data from each Bayesian trend model and
# back-transform from z-scores to original measurement units for plotting.
get_time_series <- function(model_obj) {
  mod      <- model_obj$model
  param    <- model_obj$param
  resp_var <- as.character(formula(mod)$formula)[2]
  year_seq <- tibble(Year = seq(min(std_data$Year), max(std_data$Year), by = 0.5))
  fitted_df <- fitted(mod, newdata = year_seq) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    bind_cols(year_seq) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  raw_df <- std_data |>
    select(Year, value = all_of(resp_var)) |>
    mutate(Parameter = param)
  list(fitted = fitted_df, raw = raw_df)
}

all_series <- map(temporal_models, get_time_series)

fitted_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$fitted) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    Estimate_orig = Estimate * sd + mu,
    Q2.5_orig     = Q2.5    * sd + mu,
    Q97.5_orig    = Q97.5   * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

raw_all <- map_df(all_series, ~.x$raw) |>
  left_join(slope_summary |> select(Parameter, direction), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, mu, sd, label), by = "Parameter") |>
  mutate(
    value_orig = value * sd + mu,
    label = factor(label, levels = label_levels)
  )

# show_xticks: TRUE only for bottom row (J, K = positions 9–10)
make_ts_panel <- function(param_name, letter, show_xticks = FALSE) {
  fd <- fitted_all |> filter(Parameter == param_name)
  rd <- raw_all    |> filter(Parameter == param_name)
  r2 <- r2_df      |> filter(Parameter == param_name)

  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = fd,
      aes(x = Year, ymin = Q2.5_orig, ymax = Q97.5_orig, fill = direction),
      alpha = 0.18) +
    geom_line(data = fd,
      aes(x = Year, y = Estimate_orig, color = direction),
      linewidth = 0.55) +
    geom_point(data = rd, aes(x = Year, y = value_orig),
      size = 0.85, alpha = 0.70, shape = 16, color = "grey25") +
    geom_text(data = r2, aes(label = r2_label),
      x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.4,
      size = 3.5, color = "grey45", fontface = "italic", family = "noto") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Increasing" = col_inc, "Decreasing" = col_dec)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2008, 2014, 2020)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = yaxis_labels[[param_name]], tag = letter) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = if (show_xticks)
                      element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10)
                    else
                      element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x        = if (show_xticks) element_line() else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 1, unit = "pt")),
      axis.title.y        = element_text(margin = margin(r = 1, unit = "pt")),
      axis.ticks.length.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      plot.tag.position   = c(0.04, 0.96),
      plot.tag            = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0, vjust = 1),
      plot.margin         = margin(5, 5, 5, 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}

# Summarise posterior slopes from temporal_results into median + 95% CI
slope_tbl_doc <- temporal_results |>
  group_by(Parameter) |>
  summarise(
    median_std = median(Year),
    lo95_std   = quantile(Year, 0.025),
    hi95_std   = quantile(Year, 0.975),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

slope_tbl_doc |>
  left_join(scale_params |> select(Parameter, sd, var), by = "Parameter") |>
  left_join(units_map_doc, by = "var") |>
  mutate(
    natural_slope = median_std * sd,
    natural_lo95  = lo95_std  * sd,
    natural_hi95  = hi95_std  * sd,
    credible      = sign(lo95_std) == sign(hi95_std),
    Rate = sprintf("%.3g (%s, %s)%s",
                   natural_slope,
                   formatC(natural_lo95, digits = 2, format = "g"),
                   formatC(natural_hi95, digits = 2, format = "g"),
                   if_else(credible, "\u2020", "")),
    Direction = if_else(median_std > 0, "\u2191 Increasing", "\u2193 Decreasing")
  ) |>
  arrange(median_std) |>
  select(Parameter, Units, `Rate (95% CI)` = Rate, Direction) |>
  kbl(align = c("l", "l", "r", "c")) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width        = FALSE,
    position          = "left"
  ) |>
  footnote(
    general       = "\u2020 95% credible interval excludes zero.",
    general_title = ""
  )

Structural Equation Modeling

Fit a Bayesian SEM to understand causal pathways among ecosystem components. | # | Equation | |—|———-| | 1 | Temperature ~ Year | | 2 | log(coral cover) | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ temperature + yearresid | | 3 | log(ecosystem respiration) ~ log(coral cover) + temperature | | 4 | log(fleshy macroalgae) | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ log(coral cover) | | 5 | log(Pmax) ~ log(coral cover) + temperature + log(ecosystem respiration) | | 6 | corallivore biomass ~ log(coral cover) | | 7 | herbivore biomass ~ log(fleshy macroalgae) | | 8 | log(nitrogen content) ~ log(ecosystem respiration) |

All continuous responses were log-transformed and z-score standardised before modelling. The yearresid predictor is the residual of calendar year regressed on maximum annual temperature. Because calendar year is correlated with many concurrent processes (e.g., the 2010 Acanthaster outbreak and subsequent dynamics, shifts in fishing pressure, ocean acidification, and any undetected observer or sampling effects), yearresid represents an unresolved bundle of secular non-thermal pressures operating over 2005–2025 and cannot be attributed to any single mechanism. Cover responses were upper-truncated at the z-log scale equivalent of 100% cover to respect the biological ceiling; truncation values (3.39 for coral, 2.26 for fleshy macroaglae and turf algae) were verified to back-transform to exactly 100%.

Missing predictor values (ecosystem respiration and temperature as predictors of Pmax; ecosystem respiration as predictor of N content) were handled via brms integrated missing-data imputation (mi() syntax). Priors were weakly informative: regression coefficients ~ Normal(0, 2); intercepts ~ Normal(0, 2); residual SDs ~ Normal\(_+\)(0, 0.25) for the temperature sub-model and Normal\(_+\)(0, 2) otherwise.

Temporal autocorrelation in the coral sub-model

The coral sub-model included a first-order autoregressive residual structure, specified as ar(time = Year, p = 1) within the brms formula. The AR(1) coefficient φ received a weakly informative Normal(0, 0.5) prior (the default in brms); all structural regression coefficients retained Normal(0, 2) priors. AR(1) was applied only to the coral sub-model because coral cover residuals showed the strongest temporal dependence; other residual series were inspected but showed weaker patterns. Three chains ran for 10,000 iterations (5,000 warmup) with adapt_delta = 0.99 and max_treedepth = 15. Convergence was assessed via Rhat (< 1.01 for all parameters), bulk and tail effective sample sizes (> 1,000), and posterior predictive checks.

Code 
# yearresid is the residual of calendar year after removing the temperature
# trend. It captures everything else that changed systematically over 20 years
# beyond warming — things like the 2010 Acanthaster outbreak, gradual shifts
# in fishing pressure, ocean acidification, and any other unmeasured secular
# drivers. It is deliberately a bundle of unresolved processes; we can't
# attribute it to any single mechanism, but including it prevents omitted-
# variable bias in the coral sub-model.
yearresid <- resid(lm(Year ~ Max_temp, data = Year_Averages, na.action = na.exclude))

# Prepare scaled SEM data 
semdata2 <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    logfleshy = log(mean_fleshy),
    logrd = log(Rd),
    logpmax = log(Pmax), 
    logproducers = log(mean_alive),
    N_percent = log(N_percent),
    yearresid = yearresid
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, logproducers, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp, flow = Flow_mean, Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral, logfleshy, Corallivore,
    herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))
Code 
# Define SEM structure
bf_temp <- bf(temperature | mi() ~ 1 + Year)
bf_coraltemp <- bf(logcoral | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ 1 + temperature + yearresid +
                     ar(time = Year, p = 1))
bf_logpmax <- bf(logpmax | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature) + mi(logrd)) ####
bf_logrd <- bf(logrd | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral + mi(temperature))
bf_herbs <- bf(herbs | mi() ~ 1 + logfleshy)
bf_corallivore <- bf(Corallivore | mi() ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_fleshy <- bf(logfleshy | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ logcoral)
bf_nutrients <- bf(Npercent | mi() ~ 1 + mi(logrd))

# Fit the full Bayesian SEM. The key structural choice is the AR(1) term on
# the coral sub-model — coral cover has strong year-to-year memory (a bad
# bleaching year affects the next 5–10 years), and without AR(1) the credible
# intervals on the temperature→coral path would be overconfident. We only
# apply it to coral because the other sub-models showed much weaker residual
# autocorrelation. The trunc(ub = ...) terms cap cover at 100% on the log
# scale to respect the biological ceiling. 
brms_sem_full <- brm(
  bf_temp + bf_coraltemp + bf_logrd + bf_herbs + bf_corallivore +
    bf_nutrients + bf_fleshy + bf_logpmax + set_rescor(FALSE),
  data = semdata2,
  chains = 3,
  iter = 10000,
  warmup = 5000,
  seed = 11,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior = c(
    # b-class priors per response (only for responses that have non-mi() predictors)
    # Npercent is excluded: its only predictor is mi(logrd) → class bsp, not b
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "temperature"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logcoral"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logrd"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logpmax"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "herbs"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "Corallivore"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logfleshy"),
    # Intercept priors for all responses
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "temperature"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logcoral"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logrd"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logpmax"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "herbs"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "Corallivore"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logfleshy"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "Npercent"),
    # Response-specific essential priors
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", resp = "temperature", class = "sigma", lb = 0),
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)",  class = "ar",  resp = "logcoral")
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  family = gaussian(),
  silent = 2,
  refresh = 0
)

pos_col  <- "#1565C0"
neg_col  <- "#B71C1C"
nsig_col <- "#AAAAAA"


dag_nodes <- tribble(
  ~id,           ~label,                    ~x,    ~y,    ~fill,       ~border,
  "Year",        "Year",                    0.4,   3.5,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Temp",        "Temperature",             2.0,   3.0,   "white",     "#888888",
  "Coral",       "Coral\nCover",            3.8,   3.0,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  # Ecosystem function: Rd and Pmax in horizontal row; N elevated above
  "Rd",          "Ecosystem\nRespiration",  5.6,   4.0,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  "N",           "N\nStock",               7.4,   5.0,   "#FFF8E1",   "#E65100",
  "Pmax",        "Ecosystem\nPmax",         9.2,   4.0,   "#EDE7F6",   "#4527A0",
  # Community composition row
  "Algae",       "Fleshy\nAlgae",           5.6,   2.0,   "#E8F5E9",   "#2E7D32",
  "Herbs",       "Herbivore\nFish",         7.4,   2.0,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1",
  "Corallivore", "Corallivore\nFish",       9.2,   2.0,   "#E3F2FD",   "#0D47A1"
)

dag_edges <- tribble(
  ~from,   ~to,           ~est,   ~sig,  ~loff_x, ~loff_y,
  "Year",  "Temp",        0.464,  TRUE,   0.28,    0.18,
  "Temp",  "Coral",      -0.559,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24,
  "Temp",  "Rd",          0.213,  FALSE, -0.35,    0.24,
  "Temp",  "Pmax",       -0.152,  FALSE, -0.75,   -0.22,
  "Coral", "Rd",          1.075,  TRUE,  -0.08,    0.24,
  "Coral", "Algae",      -0.659,  TRUE,  -0.08,   -0.24,
  "Coral", "Corallivore", 0.664,  TRUE,   0.38,   -0.20,
  "Coral", "Pmax",       -0.336,  FALSE,  0.38,    0.20,
  "Rd",    "N",           0.621,  TRUE,  -0.18,    0.22,   # short diagonal up-right
  "Rd",    "Pmax",        0.809,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24,   # straight horizontal below N
  "Algae", "Herbs",       0.540,  TRUE,   0.00,    0.24    # straight horizontal
) |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(est >= 0, "pos", "neg"), abs_est = abs(est)) |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(from = id, x0 = x, y0 = y), by = "from") |>
  left_join(dag_nodes |> select(id, x, y) |> rename(to   = id, x1 = x, y1 = y), by = "to") |>
  mutate(mx = (x0 + x1) / 2, my = (y0 + y1) / 2, lbl = sprintf("%.2f", est))

# All edges are straight — no geom_curve needed
dag_arr <- arrow(length = unit(3.0, "mm"), type = "closed")

fig3 <- ggplot() +
  # Faint region backgrounds
  annotate("rect", xmin = 4.8, xmax = 10.0, ymin = 3.2, ymax = 5.65,
           fill = "#EDE7F6", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 4.8, xmax = 10.0, ymin = 1.2, ymax = 2.75,
           fill = "#E3F2FD", alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  # Region labels
  annotate("text", x = 10.12, y = 4.5, label = "Ecosystem\nfunction",
           hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "#6A1B9A", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 10.12, y = 2.0, label = "Community\ncomposition",
           hjust = 0, size = 2.6, color = "#1565C0", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9) +
  # Significant edges
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_edges,  sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, color = direction, linewidth = abs_est),
    alpha = 0.82, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  # Non-significant edges — reduced alpha to de-emphasise
  geom_segment(data = filter(dag_edges, !sig),
    aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1, linewidth = abs_est),
    color = nsig_col, alpha = 0.45, arrow = dag_arr, lineend = "butt") +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_edges,  sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl, color = direction),
    size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.07, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_label(data = filter(dag_edges, !sig),
    aes(x = mx + loff_x, y = my + loff_y, label = lbl),
    color = nsig_col, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold", fill = "white",
    label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.07, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Node boxes
  {lapply(seq_len(nrow(dag_nodes)), function(i) {
    nd <- dag_nodes[i, ]
    geom_label(data = nd, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
               fill = nd$fill, color = nd$border, size = 3.0,
               fontface = "bold", lineheight = 0.9, label.size = 0.65,
               label.padding = unit(0.38, "lines"), label.r = unit(4, "pt"),
               show.legend = FALSE)
  })} +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pos" = pos_col, "neg" = neg_col),
                     labels = c("pos" = "Positive", "neg" = "Negative"),
                     name = "Effect direction") +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(0.6, 2.8), guide = "none") +
  labs(caption = "Standardized β on arrows  ·  gray = 95% CI crosses zero") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.caption    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey55", size = 9, margin = margin(t = 6)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(8, 10, 6, 10)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 11.8), ylim = c(1.35, 5.75))

# Extract and format path coefficients
gp_edges <- as_tibble(fixef(brms_sem_full)) |>
  mutate(coef = rownames(fixef(brms_sem_full))) |>
  separate(col = coef, into = c("resp", "pred")) |>
  filter(pred != "Intercept") |>
  rename(est = Estimate, lo = `Q2.5`, hi = `Q97.5`) |>
  mutate(sig = if_else(sign(lo) == sign(hi), 1, 0.5)) |>
  mutate(resp = case_when(
    resp == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    resp == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf",
    resp == "logpmax" ~ "Ecosystem Pmax",
    resp == "logrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd",
    resp == "herbs" ~ "Herbivorous Fish",
    resp == "Corallivore" ~ "Corallivore Fish",
    resp == "logcoral" ~ "Coral",
    resp == "Npercent" ~ "N stock"
  )) |>
  mutate(resp = factor(resp, c(
    "Temperature", "Coral", "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf", "Herbivorous Fish",
    "Corallivore Fish", "Ecosystem Rd", "Ecosystem Pmax", "N stock"
  ))) |>
  mutate(pred = case_when(
    pred == "temperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "mitemperature" ~ "Temperature",
    pred == "milogrd" ~ "Ecosystem Rd Rate",
    pred == "logcoral" ~ "Coral Cover",
    pred == "logfleshy" ~ "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover",
    pred == "Year" ~ "Year",
    pred == "yearresid" ~ "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability"
  )) |>
  mutate(pred = factor(pred, c(
    "Ecosystem Rd Rate", "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf Cover",
    "Coral Cover", "Non-Temperature Yearly Variability",
    "Temperature", "Year"
  )))

gp_edges |>
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = pred)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "firebrick", aes(alpha = sig)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi, alpha = sig), height = 0, color = "firebrick") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  scale_alpha(range = c(0.4, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Standardized Effect Size",
    y = "Predictor Variables"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~resp, nrow = 1) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Unscaling parameters
yearresid_full <- resid(lm(Year ~ Max_temp, data = Year_Averages, na.action = na.exclude))

Yearmodelvalues <- Year_Averages |>
  mutate(
    log_coral = log(mean_coral),
    logfleshy = log(mean_fleshy),
    logrd     = log(Rd),
    logpmax   = log(Pmax),
    N_percent = log(N_percent),
    yearresid = yearresid_full
  ) |>
  select(
    Year, meancoral = mean_coral, meanfleshy = mean_fleshy,
    temperature = Max_temp,
    Npercent = N_percent,
    logrd, logpmax, logcoral = log_coral,
    logfleshy, Corallivore, herbs = Herbivores, yearresid
  ) |>
  drop_na(logcoral)

modelmean <- Yearmodelvalues |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
modelsd   <- Yearmodelvalues |> summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE)))

  mutate(
    Year       = Year       * modelsd$Year        + modelmean$Year,
    estimate__ = estimate__ * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    lower__    = lower__    * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature,
    upper__    = upper__    * modelsd$temperature + modelmean$temperature
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Year, y = estimate__)) +

Ecosystem Projections

Code 
# These are the upper truncation values on the z-log scale that correspond to
# 100% benthic cover. They were calculated from the observed data and hardcoded
# here so that projection code uses exactly the same ceiling as the SEM.
# Both values were verified to back-transform to exactly 100% cover.
z_ceil_coral  <- 3.39   # (log(100) - mean(log(coral%))) / sd(log(coral%))
z_ceil_fleshy <- 2.26   # (log(100) - mean(log(fleshy%))) / sd(log(fleshy%))
Code 
#| label: full-sem-proj-data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Compute full-SEM projection matrices — needed by the reduced SEM comparison plot.

# ── Projection years (standardised to SEM scale) ─────────────────────────────
proj_years <- 2005:2055
year_std   <- (proj_years - modelmean$Year) / modelsd$Year

# 3 000 thinned posterior draws
set.seed(7341)
post <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_full) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  slice_sample(n = 3000)

n <- nrow(post)
p <- length(proj_years)

# Helper: multiply each row of an (n × p) matrix by a length-n coefficient vector
rs <- function(coef, mat) sweep(mat, 1, coef, "*")
yr_mat <- matrix(rep(year_std, each = n), nrow = n)  # n × p

# ── Propagate causal chain through the full SEM ───────────────────────────────
# 1. Temperature (z-scored)
temp_mat <- rs(post$b_temperature_Year, yr_mat) + post$b_temperature_Intercept

# ── yearresid matrix: observed z-scaled values for hindcast (2005–2025),
#    0 (standardised mean) for forecast years (2026–2055). yearresid captures
#    year-specific temperature anomalies beyond the linear trend; setting it to 0
#    for forecast years assumes future deviations are unknown and average out.
obs_yr_actual   <- round(semdata2$Year * modelsd$Year + modelmean$Year)
yr_resid_lookup <- tibble(Year = obs_yr_actual, yr = semdata2$yearresid)
yr_resid_vec    <- sapply(proj_years, function(y) {
  row <- yr_resid_lookup |> filter(Year == y)
  if (nrow(row) == 1 && !is.na(row$yr)) row$yr else 0
})
yr_resid_mat <- matrix(rep(yr_resid_vec, each = n), nrow = n)

# 2. Coral cover (log-standardised; temperature + yearresid predictors)
coral_mat <- rs(post$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat)    +
             rs(post$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat) +
             post$b_logcoral_Intercept

# 3. Ecosystem respiration (coral + direct temp via bsp for mi() imputed predictor)
rd_mat <- rs(post$b_logrd_logcoral,          coral_mat) +
          rs(post$bsp_logrd_mitemperature,   temp_mat)  +
          post$b_logrd_Intercept

# 4. Fleshy macroalgae (log-standardised; coral predictor)
fleshy_mat <- pmin(rs(post$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat) + post$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                   z_ceil_fleshy)

# 5. Corallivore fish (z-scored; coral predictor)
cov_mat <- rs(post$b_Corallivore_logcoral, coral_mat) + post$b_Corallivore_Intercept

# 6. Herbivore fish (z-scored; fleshy algae predictor)
herb_mat <- rs(post$b_herbs_logfleshy, fleshy_mat) + post$b_herbs_Intercept

# 7. Ecosystem Pmax (log-standardised; rd + coral + temp, all via bsp/b)
pmax_mat <- rs(post$bsp_logpmax_milogrd,      rd_mat)    +
            rs(post$b_logpmax_logcoral,        coral_mat) +
            rs(post$bsp_logpmax_mitemperature, temp_mat)  +
            post$b_logpmax_Intercept

# 8. Algal N content (log-standardised; rd via bsp imputed)
n_mat <- rs(post$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat) + post$b_Npercent_Intercept

# ── Back-transform to original units ─────────────────────────────────────────
bt_log <- function(mat, mu, sig) exp(mat * sig + mu)
bt_lin <- function(mat, mu, sig) mat * sig + mu

proj_list <- list(
  Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
  `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
  Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
  `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
  Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
  # N_percent is log-transformed in semdata2; use explicit log-scale params
  `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat,
                          mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))
)

# Derive P:R ratio directly from back-transformed Pmax and Rd matrices
proj_list[["P:R Ratio"]] <- proj_list$Pmax / proj_list$Respiration

# ── Summarise: posterior median + 50% + 95% CI per variable per year ─────────
proj_tbl <- imap_dfr(proj_list, function(mat, vname) {
  tibble(variable = vname,
         Year     = rep(proj_years, each = n),
         value    = as.vector(mat)) |>
    group_by(variable, Year) |>
    summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              lo95   = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), hi95 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
              lo50   = quantile(value, 0.25,  na.rm = TRUE), hi50 = quantile(value, 0.75,  na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
})

# ── Observed data for overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
obs_proj <- Year_Averages |>
  transmute(Year,
            Temperature    = Max_temp,
            `Coral Cover`  = mean_coral,
            Respiration    = Rd,
            `Fleshy Algae` = mean_fleshy,
            Pmax           = Pmax,
            `N Content`    = N_percent,
            `P:R Ratio`    = Pmax / Rd) |>
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "observed")

Reduced SEM: Parsimonious Model

Three of the twelve pathways in the full SEM had 95% credible intervals spanning zero — direct temperature effects on respiration, direct temperature effects on Pmax , and a direct coral effect on Pmax — indicating that these pathways are not reliably supported by the data. Retaining them in projection creates two problems: the positive temperature→Rd coefficient generates a spurious upward push on Rd when temperature is extrapolated beyond the fitted range, and the large uncertainty on the coral→Pmax and temperature→Pmax terms inflates Pmax credible intervals. A reduced 9-pathway SEM was therefore fitted with these three terms removed.

Code 
# Reduced SEM: remove 3 non-significant pathways
bf_temp_r        <- bf(temperature | mi()             ~ 1 + Year)
bf_coraltemp_r   <- bf(logcoral    | trunc(ub = 3.39) ~ 1 + temperature + yearresid +
                         ar(time = Year, p = 1))
bf_logrd_r       <- bf(logrd       | mi()             ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_logpmax_r     <- bf(logpmax     | mi()             ~ 1 + mi(logrd))
bf_fleshy_r      <- bf(logfleshy   | trunc(ub = 2.26) ~ logcoral)
bf_herbs_r       <- bf(herbs       | mi()             ~ 1 + logfleshy)
bf_corallivore_r <- bf(Corallivore | mi()             ~ 1 + logcoral)
bf_nutrients_r   <- bf(Npercent    | mi()             ~ 1 + mi(logrd))

brms_sem_reduced <- brm(
  bf_temp_r + bf_coraltemp_r + bf_logrd_r + bf_herbs_r + bf_corallivore_r +
    bf_nutrients_r + bf_fleshy_r + bf_logpmax_r + set_rescor(FALSE),
  data    = semdata2,
  chains  = 3, iter = 10000, warmup = 5000, seed = 11,
  sample_prior = "no",
  prior   = c(
    # b-class priors per response (logpmax and Npercent excluded: only mi() predictors
    # → class bsp, not b)
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "temperature"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logcoral"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logrd"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "herbs"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "Corallivore"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "b", resp = "logfleshy"),
    # Intercept priors for all responses
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "temperature"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logcoral"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logrd"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logpmax"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "herbs"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "Corallivore"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "logfleshy"),
    set_prior("normal(0, 2)", class = "Intercept", resp = "Npercent"),
    # Response-specific essential priors
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.25)", resp = "temperature", class = "sigma", lb = 0),
    set_prior("normal(0, 0.5)",  class = "ar",  resp = "logcoral")
  ),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth = 15),
  family  = gaussian(),
  silent = 2, refresh = 0
)

and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
Code 
# Manual R² for mi()-imputed responses
for (resp in c("logrd", "logpmax")) {
  fit_f <- fitted(brms_sem_full,    resp = resp)[, "Estimate"]
  fit_r <- fitted(brms_sem_reduced, resp = resp)[, "Estimate"]
  obs_v <- semdata2[[resp]]
  ok    <- !is.na(obs_v)
  cat(sprintf("%-10s  Full R²: %.3f   Reduced R²: %.3f\n", resp,
              cor(fit_f[ok], obs_v[ok])^2, cor(fit_r[ok], obs_v[ok])^2))
}

Code 
set.seed(6214)
post_r <- as_draws_df(brms_sem_reduced) |> as_tibble() |> slice_sample(n = 3000)
n_r    <- nrow(post_r)

# yearresid matrix: observed for 2005-2025, zero for 2026-2055
yr_resid_vec_r <- sapply(proj_years, function(y) {
  row <- yr_resid_lookup |> filter(Year == y)
  if (nrow(row) == 1 && !is.na(row$yr)) row$yr else 0
})
yr_resid_mat_r <- matrix(rep(yr_resid_vec_r, each = n_r), nrow = n_r)
yr_mat_r       <- matrix(rep(year_std, each = n_r), nrow = n_r)

# ── Propagate reduced SEM causal chain ────────────────────────────────────────
temp_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$b_temperature_Year,     yr_mat_r)   + post_r$b_temperature_Intercept
coral_mat_r  <- rs(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat_r) +
                rs(post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat_r) +
                post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept
rd_mat_r     <- rs(post_r$b_logrd_logcoral, coral_mat_r)      + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
fleshy_mat_r <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat_r) + post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                     z_ceil_fleshy)
cov_mat_r    <- rs(post_r$b_Corallivore_logcoral, coral_mat_r)+ post_r$b_Corallivore_Intercept
herb_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$b_herbs_logfleshy, fleshy_mat_r)    + post_r$b_herbs_Intercept
pmax_mat_r   <- rs(post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd, rd_mat_r)      + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
n_mat_r      <- rs(post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat_r)     + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

proj_list_r <- list(
  Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat_r,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
  `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat_r,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
  Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat_r,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
  `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat_r, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
  Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat_r,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
  `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat_r,
                          mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                          sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))
)
proj_list_r[["P:R Ratio"]] <- proj_list_r$Pmax / proj_list_r$Respiration

proj_tbl_r <- imap_dfr(proj_list_r, function(mat, vname) {
  tibble(variable = vname, Year = rep(proj_years, each = n_r), value = as.vector(mat)) |>
    group_by(variable, Year) |>
    summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              lo95 = quantile(value, .025, na.rm = TRUE), hi95 = quantile(value, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
              lo50 = quantile(value, .25,  na.rm = TRUE), hi50 = quantile(value, .75,  na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop")
})

# ── Counterfactual: temperature stabilised at 2025 ────────────────────────────
# temp_2025_std: z-standardised 2025 annual maximum temperature
# = (observed 2025 max temp - SEM temperature mean) / SEM temperature SD
# Use last non-NA Max_temp as the counterfactual (2025 is NA)
temp_2025_val <- Year_Averages |>
  filter(!is.na(Max_temp)) |>
  slice_max(Year, n = 1) |>
  pull(Max_temp)
temp_2025_std <- (temp_2025_val - modelmean$temperature) / modelsd$temperature
temp_mat_r_cf <- temp_mat_r
temp_mat_r_cf[, which(proj_years > 2025)] <- temp_2025_std

coral_mat_r_cf  <- rs(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature, temp_mat_r_cf)   +
                   rs(post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yr_resid_mat_r)  +
                   post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept
rd_mat_r_cf     <- rs(post_r$b_logrd_logcoral, coral_mat_r_cf)        + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
fleshy_mat_r_cf <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral, coral_mat_r_cf) + post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept,
                        z_ceil_fleshy)
pmax_mat_r_cf   <- rs(post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd, rd_mat_r_cf)        + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
n_mat_r_cf      <- rs(post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rd_mat_r_cf)       + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

proj_tbl_r_cf <- imap_dfr(
  list(Temperature    = bt_lin(temp_mat_r_cf,   modelmean$temperature, modelsd$temperature),
       `Coral Cover`  = bt_log(coral_mat_r_cf,  modelmean$logcoral,    modelsd$logcoral),
       Respiration    = bt_log(rd_mat_r_cf,     modelmean$logrd,       modelsd$logrd),
       `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fleshy_mat_r_cf, modelmean$logfleshy,   modelsd$logfleshy),
       Pmax           = bt_log(pmax_mat_r_cf,   modelmean$logpmax,     modelsd$logpmax),
       `N Content`    = bt_log(n_mat_r_cf,
                               mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                               sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE))),
  function(mat, vname) {
    tibble(variable = vname, Year = rep(proj_years, each = n_r), value = as.vector(mat)) |>
      group_by(variable, Year) |>
      summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                lo95 = quantile(value, .025, na.rm = TRUE), hi95 = quantile(value, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
                lo50 = quantile(value, .25,  na.rm = TRUE), hi50 = quantile(value, .75,  na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop")
  })

# ── Propagate each SSP scenario through the reduced SEM ──────────────────────
# Approach: two uncertainty sources are kept separate.
#
#   Temperature panel  — shows the raw CMIP6 inter-model spread (p10/p90 of
#     the 10 bias-corrected models). This ribbon is NOT derived from the SEM.
#
#   Ecological panels  — driven by a single, deterministic ensemble-median
#     temperature trajectory per scenario. All 3,000 SEM posterior draws use
#     identical temperatures, so the ribbon reflects SEM path-coefficient
#     uncertainty only. 
#


# ── Map scenario codes to experiment names used in ann_tos_bc ────────────────
ssp_experiment <- c(ssp126 = "ssp1_2_6", ssp245 = "ssp2_4_5", ssp585 = "ssp5_8_5")

# Build a bias-corrected model × year temperature matrix for a given scenario
get_model_temp_matrix <- function(scenario_name) {
  exp_name <- ssp_experiment[[scenario_name]]

  temps <- bind_rows(
    ann_tos_bc |> filter(experiment == "historical", year %in% 2005:2014),
    ann_tos_bc |> filter(experiment == exp_name,     year %in% 2015:2100)
  ) |>
    select(model, year, ann_max_bc)

  # Retain only models with a complete, non-missing 96-year series
  complete_models <- temps |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(n = n(), ok = all(!is.na(ann_max_bc)), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n == 96L, ok) |>
    pull(model)

  temps |>
    filter(model %in% complete_models) |>
    arrange(model, year) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = ann_max_bc) |>
    select(-model) |>
    as.matrix()                          # n_complete_models × 96
}

# ── CMIP6 ensemble temperature summary (for Temperature panel display) ────────
# Returns median, p10, and p90 across models for each scenario/year.
get_temp_ensemble_summary <- function(scenario_name) {
  temp_raw <- get_model_temp_matrix(scenario_name)   # n_models × 96 (2005:2100)

  # Historical (2005–2025): observed MCR temperatures, zero ribbon — mirrors the
  # two-period approach used for ecological variables so all panels are consistent.
  hist_rows <- Year_Averages |>
    filter(Year %in% 2005:2025) |>
    arrange(Year) |>
    transmute(
      scenario = scenario_name,
      variable = "Temperature",
      year     = Year,
      median   = Max_temp,
      lo95     = Max_temp, hi95 = Max_temp,
      lo50     = Max_temp, hi50 = Max_temp
    )

  # Projection (2026–2100): CMIP6 ensemble median + p10/p90 inter-model spread
  proj_rows <- tibble(
    scenario = scenario_name,
    variable = "Temperature",
    year     = 2026:2100,
    median   = apply(temp_raw[, 22:96, drop = FALSE], 2, median),
    lo95     = apply(temp_raw[, 22:96, drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, 0.10),
    hi95     = apply(temp_raw[, 22:96, drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, 0.90),
    lo50     = apply(temp_raw[, 22:96, drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, 0.25),
    hi50     = apply(temp_raw[, 22:96, drop = FALSE], 2, quantile, 0.75)
  )

  bind_rows(hist_rows, proj_rows)
}

propagate_wb_ssp <- function(scenario_name) {

  n_pct_log_mean <- mean(log(Year_Averages$N_percent), na.rm = TRUE)
  n_pct_log_sd   <- sd(log(Year_Averages$N_percent),   na.rm = TRUE)

  # ── CMIP6 ensemble-median temperature trajectory ──────────────────────────
  temp_raw     <- get_model_temp_matrix(scenario_name)
  temp_med_raw <- apply(temp_raw, 2, median)               # length 96 (2005:2100)
  temp_z_cmip6 <- (temp_med_raw - modelmean$temperature) / modelsd$temperature

  cmip6_z_2025 <- temp_z_cmip6[21]                         # index 21 = year 2025
  tm_proj      <- matrix(rep(temp_z_cmip6[22:96], each = n_r), nrow = n_r)  # n_r × 75

  # ── yearresid: held constant at its 2025 observed value ──────────────────
  # The yearresid captures secular (non-temperature) trends up to 2025. For
  # the projection period we hold it constant 
  yr_2025 <- {
    row <- yr_resid_lookup |> filter(Year == 2025L)
    if (nrow(row) == 1L && !is.na(row$yr)) row$yr else 0
  }
  yr_rv_proj <- rep(yr_2025, 75)   # constant at 2025 level throughout projection
  yrm_proj   <- matrix(rep(yr_rv_proj, each = n_r), nrow = n_r)

  # ── SEM baseline at 2025 (CMIP6 T_2025 + observed yearresid_2025) ────────
  cm_base  <- pmin(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature * cmip6_z_2025 +
                   post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid   * yr_2025 +
                   post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept, z_ceil_coral)          # n_r
  rm_base  <- post_r$b_logrd_logcoral          * cm_base + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
  fm_base  <- pmin(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral * cm_base +
                   post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept, z_ceil_fleshy)
  pm_base  <- post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd  * rm_base + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
  nm_base  <- post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd * rm_base + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

  # ── SEM projection at 2026–2100 ───────────────────────────────────────────
  cm_proj  <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logcoral_temperature, tm_proj) +
                   rs(post_r$b_logcoral_yearresid,   yrm_proj) +
                   post_r$b_logcoral_Intercept, z_ceil_coral)
  rm_proj  <- rs(post_r$b_logrd_logcoral,          cm_proj) + post_r$b_logrd_Intercept
  fm_proj  <- pmin(rs(post_r$b_logfleshy_logcoral, cm_proj) +
                   post_r$b_logfleshy_Intercept, z_ceil_fleshy)
  pm_proj  <- rs(post_r$bsp_logpmax_milogrd,  rm_proj) + post_r$b_logpmax_Intercept
  nm_proj  <- rs(post_r$bsp_Npercent_milogrd, rm_proj) + post_r$b_Npercent_Intercept

  # ── Observed z-scores at 2025 (anchor points) ────────────────────────────
  obs25 <- Year_Averages |> filter(Year == 2025)
  obs_cm_z <- (log(obs25$mean_coral)  - modelmean$logcoral)  / modelsd$logcoral
  obs_rm_z <- (log(obs25$Rd)          - modelmean$logrd)     / modelsd$logrd
  obs_fm_z <- (log(obs25$mean_fleshy) - modelmean$logfleshy) / modelsd$logfleshy
  obs_pm_z <- (log(obs25$Pmax)        - modelmean$logpmax)   / modelsd$logpmax
  # N_percent: use last non-NA year if 2025 is missing
  n_anchor <- if (!is.na(obs25$N_percent)) obs25$N_percent else {
    Year_Averages |> filter(!is.na(N_percent)) |> slice_max(Year, n = 1) |> pull(N_percent)
  }
  obs_nm_z <- (log(n_anchor) - n_pct_log_mean) / n_pct_log_sd

  # ── Delta-anchored projection matrices ───────────────────────────────────
  # anchored[draw, year] = obs_z_2025 + (proj[draw, year] - base[draw])
  cm_anch <- pmin(sweep(cm_proj, 1, cm_base, "-") + obs_cm_z, z_ceil_coral)
  rm_anch <- sweep(rm_proj, 1, rm_base, "-") + obs_rm_z
  fm_anch <- pmin(sweep(fm_proj, 1, fm_base, "-") + obs_fm_z, z_ceil_fleshy)
  pm_anch <- sweep(pm_proj, 1, pm_base, "-") + obs_pm_z
  nm_anch <- sweep(nm_proj, 1, nm_base, "-") + obs_nm_z

  proj_rows <- imap_dfr(
    list(`Coral Cover`  = bt_log(cm_anch, modelmean$logcoral,  modelsd$logcoral),
         Respiration    = bt_log(rm_anch, modelmean$logrd,     modelsd$logrd),
         `Fleshy Algae` = bt_log(fm_anch, modelmean$logfleshy, modelsd$logfleshy),
         Pmax           = bt_log(pm_anch, modelmean$logpmax,   modelsd$logpmax),
         `N Content`    = bt_log(nm_anch, n_pct_log_mean,      n_pct_log_sd)),
    function(mat, vname) {
      tibble(scenario = scenario_name, variable = vname,
             year = rep(2026:2100, each = n_r), value = as.vector(mat)) |>
        group_by(scenario, variable, year) |>
        summarise(median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                  lo95   = quantile(value, .025, na.rm = TRUE),
                  hi95   = quantile(value, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
                  lo50   = quantile(value, .25,  na.rm = TRUE),
                  hi50   = quantile(value, .75,  na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = "drop")
    })

  # ── Historical period: observed values directly, zero ribbon ─────────────
  hist_rows <- Year_Averages |>
    filter(Year %in% 2005:2025) |>
    arrange(Year) |>
    transmute(scenario = scenario_name, year = Year,
              `Coral Cover` = mean_coral, Respiration = Rd,
              `Fleshy Algae` = mean_fleshy, Pmax = Pmax, `N Content` = N_percent) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(scenario, year), names_to = "variable", values_to = "median") |>
    mutate(lo95 = median, hi95 = median, lo50 = median, hi50 = median)

  bind_rows(hist_rows, proj_rows)
}

Code 
wb_y_limits <- list(
  Temperature    = NULL,
  `Coral Cover`  = c(0, NA),
  Respiration    = c(0, NA),
  `Fleshy Algae` = c(30, 100),
  Pmax           = c(60, NA),
  `N Content`    = c(0.3, NA)
)

# Y-axis labels: variable name + (units) on new line for ≥10 pt readability
# Use expression(atop()) for labels with superscripts/subscripts — plain Unicode
# characters for those (e.g. ⁻², O₂) are not reliably covered by PDF fonts.
wb_var_labels <- list(
  Temperature    = "Temperature\n(\u00b0C)",
  `Coral Cover`  = "Coral Cover\n(% cover)",
  Respiration    = expression(atop("Ecosystem Respiration", "(mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")")),
  `Fleshy Algae` = "Fleshy Macroalgae and Turf\n(% cover)",
  Pmax           = expression(atop("Ecosystem P"[max], "(mmol O"[2]*" m"^-2*" hr"^-1*")")),
  `N Content`    = "Algal N Content\n(% N)"
)

# Smooth trajectories for cleaner visualisation (projection period only):
#   Temperature  → median smoothed k=11; ribbon (inter-model p10/p90) smoothed k=5.
#   Ecological   → both median and ribbons smoothed k=5.
# Historical period (2005–2025) is never smoothed; observed values are unchanged.
wb_plot_tbl_smooth <- wb_plot_tbl |>
  dplyr::group_by(variable, scenario) |>
  dplyr::arrange(year) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_temp = as.character(variable) == "Temperature",
    k       = dplyr::if_else(is_temp, 11L, 5L),
    in_proj = year > 2025,
    median_s = dplyr::if_else(
      in_proj,
      zoo::rollapply(median, width = k[1], FUN = mean, align = "center",
                     partial = TRUE, fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      median
    ),
    lo95_s = dplyr::if_else(
      in_proj,
      zoo::rollapply(lo95, width = 5L, FUN = mean, align = "center",
                     partial = TRUE, fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      lo95
    ),
    hi95_s = dplyr::if_else(
      in_proj,
      zoo::rollapply(hi95, width = 5L, FUN = mean, align = "center",
                     partial = TRUE, fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE),
      hi95
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

make_wb_panel <- function(vname) {
  d_proj <- wb_plot_tbl_smooth |> filter(variable == vname, year > 2025)
  obs_v  <- Year_Averages |>
    select(year = Year,
           Temperature    = Max_temp,
           `Coral Cover`  = mean_coral,
           Respiration    = Rd,
           `Fleshy Algae` = mean_fleshy,
           Pmax           = Pmax,
           `N Content`    = N_percent) |>
    pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "obs") |>
    filter(variable == vname)
  ylim <- wb_y_limits[[vname]]
  ylab <- wb_var_labels[[vname]]

  # Ribbon and lines drawn only for projection period (2026–2100);
  # hindcast (2005–2025) shows raw observed points only.
  p <- ggplot(mapping = aes(colour = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2025.5, xmax = 2100, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "grey92", alpha = .6) +
    geom_ribbon(data = d_proj, aes(x = year, ymin = lo95_s, ymax = hi95_s),
                alpha = 0.25, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(data = d_proj, aes(x = year, y = median_s), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = obs_v, aes(x = year, y = obs),
               colour = "black", size = 1.5, shape = 21, fill = "white",
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2025.5, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = .4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = wb_ssp_colours, labels = wb_ssp_labels, name = "Scenario") +
    scale_fill_manual(  values = wb_ssp_colours, labels = wb_ssp_labels, name = "Scenario") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2010, 2100, 20)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 1.1)
    )
  if (!is.null(ylim)) p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  p
}

wb_panels <- lapply(wb_var_order, make_wb_panel)

  rownames_to_column("param") |>

  resp  = c("temperature", "logcoral", "logrd",  "logfleshy",
            "Corallivore", "herbs",    "logpmax", "Npercent"),
  label = c("Temperature", "Coral cover", "Ecosystem\nrespiration", "Fleshy\nmacroalgae\n& turf",
            "Corallivore\nbiomass", "Herbivore\nbiomass", "Ecosystem\nPmax", "Algal N\ncontent")

# Actual calendar years aligned to semdata2 rows
# actual_years must match rows brms used: excludes years where any non-mi()
# predictor is NA (i.e. yearresid = NA when Max_temp = NA for 2025)
actual_years <- Year_Averages |>
  filter(!is.na(log_coral), !is.na(Max_temp)) |>
  pull(Year)

obs_fit_df <- resp_meta$resp |>
  map(function(r) {
    obs  <- semdata2[[r]]
    fit  <- fitted(brms_sem_reduced, resp = r)[, c("Estimate", "Q2.5", "Q97.5")]
    n_fit <- nrow(fit)
    tibble(
      Year     = actual_years[seq_len(n_fit)],
      observed = obs[seq_len(n_fit)],
      fitted   = fit[, "Estimate"],
      lo95     = fit[, "Q2.5"],
      hi95     = fit[, "Q97.5"],
      resp     = r
    )
  }) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  left_join(resp_meta, by = "resp") |>
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = resp_meta$label))

Supplementary Table 1: SEM Path Coefficients

Code 
# Build tidy table from brms fixed effects summary
sem_coef_table <- as.data.frame(summary(brms_sem_full)$fixed) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
  # Keep only regression coefficients (exclude intercepts)
  filter(!grepl("Intercept", term)) |>
  mutate(
    # Parse response and predictor from "response_predictor" format
    Pathway = case_when(
      term == "temperature_Year"         ~ "Year → Temperature",
      term == "logcoral_temperature"     ~ "Temperature → Coral cover",
      term == "logcoral_yearresid"       ~ "Year residual → Coral cover",
      term == "logrd_logcoral"           ~ "Coral cover → Ecosystem respiration",
      term == "logrd_mitemperature"      ~ "Temperature → Ecosystem respiration (direct)",
      term == "logfleshy_logcoral"       ~ "Coral cover → Fleshy macroalgae",
      term == "Corallivore_logcoral"     ~ "Coral cover → Corallivore biomass",
      term == "herbs_logfleshy"          ~ "Fleshy macroalgae → Herbivore biomass",
      term == "logpmax_milogrd"          ~ "Ecosystem respiration → Ecosystem Pmax",
      term == "logpmax_logcoral"         ~ "Coral cover → Ecosystem Pmax (direct)",
      term == "logpmax_mitemperature"    ~ "Temperature → Ecosystem Pmax (direct)",
      term == "Npercent_milogrd"         ~ "Ecosystem respiration → Algal N content",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    Credible = if_else(sign(`l-95% CI`) == sign(`u-95% CI`), "†", ""),
    beta  = sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
    CI    = sprintf("[%.3f, %.3f]", `l-95% CI`, `u-95% CI`),
    Rhat  = sprintf("%.4f", Rhat),
    BESS  = formatC(round(Bulk_ESS), format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    TESS  = formatC(round(Tail_ESS), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  # Order by causal chain
  mutate(order = case_when(
    grepl("Year →",              Pathway) ~ 1,
    grepl("Temperature →",       Pathway) ~ 2,
    grepl("Year residual →",     Pathway) ~ 2,
    grepl("Coral cover →",       Pathway) ~ 3,
    grepl("Fleshy macroalgae →", Pathway) ~ 4,
    grepl("Ecosystem respiration →", Pathway) ~ 5,
    TRUE ~ 6
  )) |>
  arrange(order, Pathway) |>
  select(Pathway, Credible, beta, CI, Rhat, `Bulk ESS` = BESS, `Tail ESS` = TESS)

kable(sem_coef_table, align = c("l", "c", "r", "c", "r", "r", "r"),
      col.names = c("Pathway", "", "β", "95% CI", "R̂", "Bulk ESS", "Tail ESS")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 12) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "14em") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "1em") |>
  footnote(symbol = "95% credible interval excludes zero.")

Software and Reproducibility

Key packages: tidyverse 2.0 (Wickham et al. 2019), brms 2.21 (Bürkner 2017), tidybayes 3.0 (Kay 2023), patchwork 1.2 (Pedersen 2024), ggraph 2.1 and igraph 1.6 (Csárdi & Nepusz 2006), httr2 (Wickham 2023), zoo (Zeileis & Grothendieck 2005), cowplot (Wilke 2024), ecmwfr (Hufkens et al. 2019; https://bluegreen-labs.github.io/ecmwfr/), ncdf4 (Pierce 2024). Stan 2.32 served as the computational backend. CMIP6 SST data were accessed from the Copernicus Climate Data Store (https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/projections-cmip6; DOI: 10.24381/cds.c866074c). MCR LTER raw data are publicly archived through the EDI Data Portal (https://edirepository.org).
